answer_1.quote: LLM generates query expansions that are grounded to the document corpus while preserving user-specified document relations.

answer_2.quote: We use the official test sets of synthetic queries and leave-out sets of human-generated queries in the STaRK benchmark as well as the following evaluation metrics: Hit@1, Hit@5, Recall@20 (R@20), and Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR).
